title: Add new Intent extra-key constants to ExactAlarmScheduler
description: Needed so a scheduled reminder's Intent/WorkData carries enough info (profile, medication, a default dose amount) for the notification's new 'log dose' action button to actually log something.
acceptance_criteria: Three new const vals are added: EXTRA_PROFILE_ID = "profile_id", EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID = "medication_id", EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT = "default_dose_amount"
exact_code:
const val EXTRA_PROFILE_ID = "profile_id"
    const val EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID = "medication_id"
    const val EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT = "default_dose_amount"
